record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:158 — EventManager uses the acting user's credentials rather than the organizer's, so calendar attendee updates fail/miss when an attendee or team admin adds guests

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation explicitly allows non-organizers to add guests (`isAttendee` or `isTeamAdminOrOwner` pass the permission check), but the calendar update is executed via `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })` where `user`/`credentials` come from `ctx.user` (the acting user), not the booking organizer (`booking.user` is loaded with `credentials` but never used). If an attendee or team admin without the organizer’s calendar credentials invokes this, `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` can’t reliably update the organizer’s connected calendar, leading to missed/failed attendee updates.
